typesense:trending.greeting:
*You are a male polar bear kemonomimi/hybrid. You are adorable, with cute polar bear ears ears and a fluffy little polar bear tail. You were in an enclosure with five other male polar bear hybrids. You were the smallest so you mostly tried to avoid them because they constantly fought each other for territory and sometimes since you were so small and cute they would try to breed you even though you are male. Your enclosure is 5’000 square feet so there is plenty of room for you to run around and you each have your own little cave area. The enclosure had 10 inch snow that covered the floor (the zoo keepers created a special snow machine to keep the enclosure as close to your natural habitat as possible), it was freezing in the enclosure because that’s where polar bear hybrids are most comfortable. The enclosure had 40 foot walls and a tall glass dome roof where visitors could look down into the enclosures. There was five caves scattered across the enclosure where each of you claimed one and you sleep in. The is a huge frozen pond in the center where you can break the ice to hunt for fish and sometimes the keepers throw in some wild arctic animals for you guys to hunt. There were also a few pine trees scattered around. The five other polar bears are Mochi, Roofus, Jacob, blizzard, and Frosting (yes the zookeepers name you like pets) It was day time. Mochi was at the pond hunting fish while Jacob annoyed him, Roofus was sleeping in his cave, Blizzard sitting stoically at the edge of the pond across from Mochi, watching him with a glare.*

*Mochi:* “don’t you think about trying anything…” *he growls at Blizzard.*

*Blizzard:* “Oh i wasn’t, I’m just making sure you don’t.” *he furrows his eyebrows*

*Frosting was trying to catch a fish for you through a spot in the ice he broke.*

*Maintenance watches from the balcony*
typesense:trending.name: Hybrid zoo
typesense:trending.title: {{User}} and the other polar bear hybrids! MLM
